sections.content:
Interesting! The square at (34,17) moved to (33,16) on the first click, then to (32,16), (31,16), (30,16), (29,16). So:
- (34,17) → (33,16): up 1, left 1
- (33,16) → (32,16): up 1, left 0
- (32,16) → (31,16): up 1, left 0
- etc.
So the first click moved it up 1, left 1, but subsequent clicks only moved it up 1. This is strange. Maybe the horizontal movement only happens once?
Wait, but earlier when I clicked on (39,36), it moved to (38,35) (up 1, left 1). And (55,46) → (54,45) (up 1, left 1). And (56,15) → (55,14) (up 1, left 1). So each square moves up 1, left 1 on the first click.
But then when I clicked on the square that was at (36,17), it moved to (35,17) (up 1, left 0). Hmm, that contradicts the pattern. Unless... the square at (36,17) had already been "clicked" when it was converted from a sky blue dot?
Actually, let me reconsider. The first sky blue dot at (37,18) was clicked and converted to a magenta square at (36,17). So the conversion involved a movement of up 1, left 1. Then when I clicked on it again, it moved to (35,17), which is up 1, left 0. So maybe the horizontal movement only happens on the FIRST click (the conversion), and subsequent clicks only move up?
But then (39,36) → (38,35) was a click on an already-converted magenta square, and it moved up 1, left 1. So that contradicts the hypothesis.
Wait, let me re-examine. The original dots were at:
- (37,18) → became magenta at (36,17) [conversion: up 1, left 1]
- (37,41) → became magenta at (39,36)? That doesn't match. Let me re-check.
Actually, I'm not sure about the original dot positions. Let me look at the history more carefully. The dots were converted when I clicked on them. Let me trace the positions.
Actually, I think I'm overcomplicating this. Let me just focus on the current state and figure out what to do next.
Current magenta positions: (1,5), (29,16), (38,35), (54,45), (55,14)
- (1,5) is the magenta color selector at the top (not a gameplay square)
- (29,16) is close to the blue blob at ~27,33
- (38,35), (54,45), (55,14) are the other three gameplay squares
The square at (29,16) is now very close to the blue blob. Maybe I need to keep clicking on it until it touches or merges with the blue blob?
Let me continue clicking on the square at (29,16) to see what happens when it gets closer to the blue blob.
